papers.title: Reinforcement Learning in Machine Learning
papers.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a machine-learning approach for problems in which decisions are made repeatedly and their quality becomes clear through feedback. Instead of depending on a fixed collection of labelled answers, an RL agent interacts with an environment, observes its changing state, receives rewards or penalties, and improves its decision policy through experience. This review examines the basic RL framework and discusses deep reinforcement learning, offline learning, multi-agent systems, and human-guided learning. papers.summary: As humanoid robots are increasingly used in complex real-world environments, reliable verification of robot actions becomes more important. Source Code and Evaluation Data for Adaptive MPC Safety Shield in Microrobot Navigation
papers.summary: This repository contains the complete source code, configuration files, and raw evaluation data associated with the study on microrobot navigation. It includes the Python implementation of the Adaptive MPC Safety Shield integrated with DreamerV3 and TQC reinforcement learning algorithms. Additionally, it provides the simulation environment scripts, hyperparameter settings, and the categorical outcome datasets (success, collision, timeout rates) used to generate the figures and results in the accompanying manuscript.

papers.title: Enantioselective Benzylic C–H Insertions with Diazosuccinate Esters
papers.summary: Abstract The first enantioselective benzylic C–H insertion using α-alkyl-α-diazoesters, facilitated by a well-established chiral dirhodium(II) catalyst, is presented.
